coverage_notes: The target paragraphs concern defense, indemnification, and exceptions to an indemnity assurance. These are operative, but no supplied activity represents defending, indemnifying, or limiting an indemnity obligation; no activity clause is added. The surrounding CLA provisions are available in the full original, so this is an activity-scope limitation, not a missing-source issue.

paragraph_audit.reason: Section 9(b) requires Cohere to defend, indemnify, and hold Client and its assigns harmless for specified third-party intellectual-property claims, subject to exceptions. The unmatched action is defending and indemnifying Client; no allowed activity represents that obligation.

Section 9(d) requires Client to defend, indemnify, and hold Cohere and listed related persons harmless for specified claims. The unmatched action is defending and indemnifying Cohere and those persons; no allowed activity represents that obligation.

Section 9(e)(i) requires Cohere to defend and indemnify Client and listed related persons against specified third-party copyright claims concerning Client Output. The unmatched action is defending and indemnifying those parties; no allowed activity represents that assurance.

Section 9(e)(ii)(A) excludes the Copyright Assurance when Client is not required to pay any Fees. This is a condition on an indemnity assurance, not a condition on an allowed activity; no allowed activity represents that assurance.

Section 9(e)(ii)(B) excludes the Copyright Assurance if Client has breached the Partner Terms or CLA. This is a condition on an indemnity assurance, not a condition on an allowed activity; no allowed activity represents that assurance.

Section 9(e)(ii)(C) excludes the Copyright Assurance if, in Cohere’s reasonable discretion, Client intentionally used the Cohere Products to generate potentially infringing Client Outputs. This is a condition on an indemnity assurance, not a condition on an allowed activity; no allowed activity represents that assurance.

Section 9(e)(ii)(D) excludes the Copyright Assurance for claims resulting from finetuning or modifications of the Cohere Products. This is a condition on an indemnity assurance, not a condition on an allowed activity; no allowed activity represents that assurance.
